Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Aarav - 11 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Sunita - 36 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Karan - 37 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama
4. Aditya - 8 years, friend
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
5. Naira - 9 years, friend
Look: yellow frock, two plaits

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Aarav stands in the living room. Sunita, Karan and Aditya stand near him.]

Aditya: "Today feels like a good day."

[Aarav does his homework at the table.]

Aarav: "Aditya, listen!"

[Aarav talks to his father on the phone.]

Aarav: "Exactly right."

[Aarav types on his laptop.]

Sunita: "Karan, are you okay?"

Scene 2: The main road - Day

[Aarav stands on the road. Sunita and Karan stand near him.]

Karan: "So, here we are!"

[Father drives the car; Mother sits beside him in the front and Aarav sits in the back seat.]

Aarav: "How beautiful!"

[Aarav sits in the front passenger seat while Mother drives.]

Aarav (gently): "This is amazing!"

[The family gets into the car: Father at the wheel, Aarav in the back.]

Aarav: "That's easy."

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

Karan: "So, here we are!"

[It starts to rain.]

Aarav (happily): "Yes, of course."

[Suddenly it begins to pour.]

Sunita: "One more time!"

[Thunder rumbles in the distance.]

Karan: "Yes, of course."

[A cool breeze blows through the courtyard.]

Sunita: "That was fun!"

[Thick fog covers the village.]

Sunita: "That was such a fun day!"
